comment: A string, or a {lang: value} map on a scheming portal (title_translated); the preferred-language value is taken.
Fallback when title is empty.
The dataset description (Markdown or plain text), kept as written.
Fallback when notes is empty.
tag.display_name or name; a tag with a vocabulary_id becomes a DefinedTerm in that scheme, otherwise a plain string.
A scheming portal's keywords: a list, or a {lang: [list]} map (all languages are flattened).
DCAT theme(s) -> DefinedTerm in the set 'CKAN theme'.
Canada's subject codes -> DefinedTerm in 'CKAN subject'.
ISO topic category -> DefinedTerm in 'CKAN topic_category'.
Group memberships (on HDX, the countries) -> DefinedTerm in 'CKAN groups'. CDIF has no dataset-group relation.
license_title (or license_id) with license_url -> a CreativeWork. Reads all three license_* fields.
isopen = true -> a note; used only when no licence is named.
author (with author_email) -> the creator; a value with a space is a Person, else an Organization.
maintainer (with maintainer_email) -> a schema:Role pointOfContact.
contact_name / contact_email (DCAT-AP scheming) -> a Role pointOfContact. Reads both fields.
The owning organization -> a schema:Organization publisher (title, id, image_url as logo, description).
When the package was created in the catalog.
Canada's publication date.
DCAT-AP issued date; used when date_published is absent.
When the package last changed; also the catalog record's date.
The metadata record's modification date.
A start field paired with its end -> an ISO 8601 interval. Reads time_period_coverage_*, temporal_*, and the _extras temporal_coverage_* pair.
A GeoJSON geometry (top-level on a scheming portal) -> a Place with its bounding box.
The ckanext-spatial `spatial` extra (GeoJSON) -> a Place with its bounding box.
The ckanext-spatial bbox-west-long / -east-long / -south-lat / -north-lat extras -> a Place box. Reads all four.
A named region -> a Place.
Each resource with an http URL -> a schema:DataDownload (name or format, description, mimetype/format -> encodingFormat, size bytes -> contentSize).
The package's own `url` field (the source landing page), when it is a URL.
Every extra no row above mapped -> a PropertyValue named by its key; harvester bookkeeping (harvest*) is dropped. This row must stay after the _extras rows.
The uuid and the slug (name) become schema:identifier and the @id (https://{host}/dataset/{name}, or the DOI when digital_object_identifier is present); handled in code.
active/deleted, private, num_resources, num_tags, revision ids, tracking_summary and view counts are not converted.
relationships_as_subject / _as_object (parent/child/derives) are not converted.
